value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER. A high fever with a stiff neck, severe headache and light bothering the eyes, all together, needs urgent assessment in hospital. Please don't wait to see if it settles.
value.triage: Go to the nearest ER right now. Call 911 now if your child is confused, very drowsy or hard to wake, has a seizure, or has a rash that does not fade when pressed. 811 is for non-urgent nurse advice, so don't delay the ER to call it.
